notes.title: eSports Legend | v1.1.25 update
notes.notes:
Hello~Long time no see everybody! As the playoffs reach their climax, we decided to increase the latest game simulation system for you to play. Here are the details of this update:


1. Increase the playoff simulation system, add the new competition mode and 5 teams to compete in.

2.  Add the batch usage of items

3. Fix some bugs of clicks on some pages

4. Other details optimization and bug fix

notes.title: eSports Legend | v1.1.23 update
notes.notes:
The new updates are as follows:

1, The rules of the match are greatly adjusted, the league is divided into two stages, group matches and knockouts! The knockout stage will be played continuously!


2. New staff skills, each staff member is unique.


3. New competition rest system, you can use staff skills during this time period, allocate time reasonably, and let the players meet the next game in a better state!


4, The new expert game mode (optional when creating a new game), in this mode, all NPC teams will gradually become stronger, they are no longer sparring partners!


5. More than 40 teams have been added.


6, Other details and bug fixing.

notes.title: eSports Legend 1.1.19 Update Log
notes.notes:
1、Battle Master system has been added, and you can now update your players' talents
2、To celebrate Ig enters the final, we have re-adjusted the current player data and added the S8 Global Finals season.
3、More selections in logo customization section
4、Fix some loading bar problem
5、Fix the problem that the basic skills may be replaced
6、Fix the problem about skill
7、Fix the problem that the animation of selling items may be kept
8、Fix the problem about an achievement
9、Polish some translation
10、Add a real sponsor, thanks AutoFull!

Battle Master System:
In this new version, you can select battle master system to train your players with external players. Raise their rankings and give them new talents

notes.title: eSports Legend 1.1.15 Update Log
notes.notes:
1) Fix the broken save data problem, now the game will keep the lastest 5 days data, and if your current data is broken, you can restore the data
2) Fix the resolution problem
3) Fix the problem that there will be no buttons after entering the game
4) Fix the problem that the game will stuck after clicking some buttoms
5) Fixing the achievement bug, now your in-game achievements will be uploaded to the server

And here is what we are going to do in the next version:
1) Allow your to update your players' talents
2) Polish the in-game orders, make them more effective and real-time
3) Optimize the game stability 

Thanks for your support our game, enjoy~
